detail.longDescription: This week I wrote about how, simple or complex, what works for others might be a distraction for you. It might just be time to stop dissecting and start doing. Daily notes in apps like Obsidian work well for many people, but they don't work for me. I still love the idea and the look of them, but I've learned they aren't a good fit for me. https:// ellanew.com/2026/10/05/ptpl-22 7-daily-notes-were-messing-with-my-head # PTPL # productivity # obsidian
